description: Canonical aggregate benchmark files in results/ and lineage of superseded local runs. Every canonical file was run on a clean committed tree (zero -dirty SHAs). Full per-query traces stay local under reports/ (gitignored).

canonical_offline_retrieval.scope: 5 retrieval configurations on n=61 answerable (span-overlap >= 50%, B=2,000 bootstrap CIs) + n=19 negatives

canonical_dspy_holdout.scope: Quarantined 32-item test split (n=24 answerable for correctness/faithfulness, n=8 traps for refusal); span-resolved oracle vs retrieved hybrid top-4 arms

superseded_runs.reason: Used max_tokens=500 on reasoning models (truncating 11/80 DeepSeek static, 51/80 Qwen static, and 7/80 agentic outputs to empty strings), an un-rejudged lexical fallback report in the earlier paradigm table, and a Hop-2 grader slice bug (chunks[:4]).

DSPy compile/holdout built oracle, train, and dev contexts from stale ground_truth_context_ids instead of ground_truth_spans (mismatching 20/24 test and 29/37 train/dev answerable items, dragging oracle correctness to 41.5%).

First max_tokens=4000 rerun was executed on uncommitted code (recording git_sha bb48ee3), lacked the K=8 control and CRAG query-rewrite node, and mixed 8 traps into DSPy correctness. Superseded by clean-SHA 22edfc7 runs.

probe_labels_scope.purpose: In-sample regression guard for offline lexical judge—not independent multi-annotator consensus on live model outputs.
